ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-light-tan sliced pieces with golden-brown breaded/crusted edges, several strips about 4-6 cm long and 1-1.5 cm wide, moist-looking, lying in a loose cluster in the upper-center of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Pizza-style wedge with melted pale cheese, orange-red sauce spots, and a browned crust edge, one triangular slice about 12 cm long at the upper-right corner, with a thin layer of reddish sauce visible under the cheese | 95
ITEM 3 | Granular grain mixture with tan-brown kernels and small green flecks, loosely piled crumbly mound about 6 cm by 5 cm, dry-looking with individual grains visible, scattered loose grains around it | 75
ITEM 4 | Bright green florets with dark green tops and pale stems, clustered in a mound about 9 cm by 8 cm, moist surface with slight sheen, several small loose pieces nearby | 85
ITEM 5 | Single rounded patty-shaped piece about 5 cm across and 2 cm thick, golden-brown seared exterior with darker browned edges, lighter pale interior, firm-looking, sitting at the right side of the broccoli | 60
